name: cmux.opener/1
docs: Open links the person clicks. A clicked link goes to the app whose options.urls pattern matches it (`*` is any run of characters, matched case-insensitively), or whose schemes list its scheme, before cmux opens it itself. The most specific pattern (the most literal characters) wins, then the lowest app id; a scheme alone is the least specific. The export gets {url}; a failed open falls back to cmux's own.

urls.description: URL patterns this app opens, for example https://jira.example/browse/*.

status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
